## 56.3.5.3 MCPWM-Related ETM Tasks

When setting the enable field to 1, after inputting valid tasks, the corresponding response operation would be generated. For details, please refer to Table 56.3-8 below:

Table 56.3-8. ETM Related Tasks
| Enable Field                     | Valid Task Input                                    | Response Operation                                                                 |
|----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| MCPWMm_TASKmCAPnm_EN             | MCPWMm_TASKmCAPn                                     | CAPn channel performs a capture operation                                         |
| MCPWMm_TASKmCLRnmm_OST_EN        | MCPWMm_TASKmCLRnm_OST                                | PWM operator n clears the One-Shot Trip operation                                  |
| MCPWMm_TASKmTZnm_OST_EN          | MCPWMm_TASKmTZnm_OST                                 | PWM operator n performs a One-Shot Trip (OST) operation                            |
